blocker: session/new returns -32000 "Authentication required"; the captured account needs GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT set before an ACP session can open, so no session and no turn exist to project
notes: Real captured handshake. The contract covers the frames that exist rather than the turn that never happened: initialize succeeds, the agent advertises oauth-personal, gemini-api-key and vertex-ai, and session/new is refused.
The empty events array is asserted, not skipped. It states that a refused session produces no transcript items at all, which is the behaviour a regression would break by inventing an item or a turn.
handshake signInRequired asserts that StandardAcpRuntime maps -32000 "Authentication required" onto SignInRequired rather than a frame error, which is the whole of what this trace can prove.

The capture contains a non-JSON stdout line before the first frame ("Data collection is disabled."), recorded as a raw entry. wire.rs stays strict about frame decoding; skipping that preamble belongs in the stdout line-splitting layer, bounded to before the first successful frame and surfaced as a diagnostic.
Re-record the turn scenarios once GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT is available, then replace the empty events array with the projected turn.
